propositions: Fourteen test modules hand-build nested pytest invocations with duplicated decisions on basetemp, timeout, cache plugin, and env
Three test files lack --basetemp: test_bare_repository_fixture_portability_heldout.py, test_git_version_floor.py, and test_live_jira_xdist_confinement.py
A consolidated run_nested_pytest helper function must accept env as required verbatim parameter (never merged onto os.environ) and forward it byte-identically to preserve security oracle tests
The helper must build [sys.executable, -m, pytest, *args, --basetemp, str(tmp_path/nested-pytest)] and pass timeout as a subprocess.run keyword, returning the CompletedProcess unmodified
An AST scan guard must find exactly one run_nested_pytest definition and exactly fourteen nested-pytest launch sites under tests/, with escape marker support for unconverted console-script sites
